_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Priest tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped. discipline_pd = Discipline/Power-Word family. Forever renames/new vs Cata: Power Word: Shield also as Power Word: Barrier (CD side), Spirit of Redemption active -> Spirit of the Redeemer, Shadow Word: Death, Shadowguard, Hex/Touch of Weakness, Eye of the Void, Void Zone/Shadowfiend/Devouring Plague + Void Plague, Chastise (the Forever smite-strike), Deliverance, Levitate as a priest buff. Circle of Healing, Eye of the Void, Homunculi, Power Word: Barrier and Void Plague also exist as Mage cross-class talent rows; the generator resolves them to Priest rows via its family-scoped rank resolution.
